title: Android Studio, SDKs, and Virtual Devices Quick Check

questions.prompt: What is an Android Virtual Device?
questions.answer: A saved emulator hardware and system-image configuration
questions.explanation: An AVD defines the virtual device that the emulator process boots.
options: A saved emulator hardware and system-image configuration

questions.prompt: Order the boundaries in a normal run.
questions.explanation: The app must be built before it can be installed and launched on a connected target.

questions.prompt: adb is used to communicate with Android devices and emulators.
questions.explanation: Android Debug Bridge provides the host-to-device connection used by installation, shell, logs, and debugging tools.
